title: Lexicon entry, version 1
description: One shown entry of the Infinite Flow lexicon, as the lexicon API hands it out (docs/lexicon-api.md). Every field is required and no other field is allowed. Text fields hold the lexicon's light inline marks as written.

id.description: The entry's id, unique among the entries.

otherNames.description: Its other names, in the lexicon's order; empty when the lexicon says none.

appMeaning.description: Its app meaning, as written; null when the entry has none.

related.description: The ids of its related entries that are shown entries, in the lexicon's order.

group.description: Its group's name, as the lexicon heads it.

groupOrder.description: Its group's place in the lexicon's order, from 1.
